help:
A Sentinel is hidden somewhere in San Andreas. Can you find it? Take a screenshot, and DM it to LotsOfS to prove yourself!
There is no reward for finding it, but maybe keep the screenshot of it around on your hard drive just in case. Make sure to show the scoreboard so you can prove it's your screenshot.
The Sentinel will remain in its location until it has been found by someone, then it'll be hidden elsewhere on the next server update.
